data.exact_reserve_text: It is disappointing to record a loss for the year, which is driven primarily by reserves strengthening on discontinued business plus reserves for possible claims arising from the COVID-19 pandemic.

named_events.loss_description: The syndicate has recorded a net loss reserve of GBP 7.5m

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 39.864m. Using the gross claims development triangle the syndicate recorded adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 11.431m (about 28.7% of opening reserves), driven by reserve strengthening on discontinued business and additional provisions for possible COVID-19-related claims. The movement principally relates to older underwriting years (notably 2018) and affects the syndicate's professional lines exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: reserves for possible claims arising from the COVID-19 pandemic
there is uncertainty in all loss reserves
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred claims) because there is no explicit 'movement in prior years' gross figure in the notes. The triangle only contains an individual older underwriting year (2018), so the PYD reflects changes in that year only. COVID-19 amounts quoted in the report are net reserves; gross by-LOB movements are not provided, so LOB amounts are null where gross figures are not available.
